name: colliedesk
description: Work your Colliedesk inbox from Claude: find, read and triage conversations, leave notes and draft replies.
long_description: Connects Claude Desktop to your Colliedesk, on Colliedesk Cloud or your own server, with an agent token. The token's tier decides what Claude may do; anything above it waits for a person to approve in Colliedesk.

url.title: Colliedesk address
url.description: The address you open Colliedesk at, for example https://acme.colliedesk.com

token.title: Agent token
token.description: Create one in Colliedesk under Settings → Sessions. It starts with cdk_agent_; Claude Desktop stores it securely.
